meta.name: reserved-keyword-cli-custom-commands
meta.description: How to author custom commands for the reserved-keyword-cli CLI using the co-generated SDK.

copy.tagline: 教你为 reserved-keyword-cli 编写自定义命令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想给 CLI 工具添加自定义命令
copy.tagline_en: Learn to author custom commands for reserved-keyword-cli
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add custom commands to a CLI tool

howto.what: 用户可以编写自定义命令并编译到 reserved-keyword-cli 中。自定义命令自动获得 SDK 客户端，集成认证、重试等配置，无需额外设置。
howto.when: 用户编辑 custom.rs 文件注册命令，运行 cargo build 编译后，即可通过 reserved-keyword-cli 执行自定义命令。

say.text: 帮我创建一个自定义 get 命令，需要 model_id 参数。
say.note: 将生成 register 函数中的命令定义。

say.text: 为我的 CLI 添加一个异步调用 models.get 的命令。
say.note: 需使用 block_on 执行异步操作。

howto.what_en: Users can author custom commands that get compiled into the reserved-keyword-cli binary. Custom commands automatically receive a fully-wired SDK client inheriting auth, retry, TLS, base URL, and global headers with zero configuration.
howto.when_en: After editing custom.rs to register commands and running cargo build, the custom commands can be executed via reserved-keyword-cli.

say_en.text: Add a custom 'get' command that requires a model_id argument.
Add a command that calls models.get asynchronously.
